events.text: Egypt has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Vine (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production and +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for each [ICON_RES_WINE] Wine, [ICON_RES_BEER] Beer, and [ICON_RES_COGNAC] Cognac resource)
The Shoshone have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Ancestor Worship (+1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture and +1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from [ICON_BUILDING_SHRINE] Shrines)

Spain has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: God of the Sea (+1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production from Fishing Boats and Atolls, a free Work Boat appears near the [ICON_CAPITAL] Capital)

Siam has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Sun God (+1 [ICON_FOOD] Food for each [ICON_RES_WHEAT] Wheat, Banana, [ICON_RES_CITRUS] Citrus, [ICON_RES_COCOA] Cocoa, and [ICON_RES_PINEAPPLE] Pineapple resource)
The Inca have started worshipping a pantheon of gods. They have chosen the belief: Desert Fox (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith from Desert tiles)
A golden age begins for the Siamese civilization.

Egypt has founded the new religion Judaism in the holy city of Thebes:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Daily Bread[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_PALACE] Palace provides +6 [ICON_FOOD] Food[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Feed the World[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_SHRINE] Shrines provide +1 [ICON_FOOD] and [ICON_BUILDING_TEMPLE] Temples provide +2 [ICON_FOOD] Food each. [ICON_BUILDING_GRAND_TEMPLE] Grand Temple provides +5 [ICON_FOOD] Food

The Shoshone have founded the new religion Buddhism in the holy city of Moson Kahni:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Voice of Prophets[ENDCOLOR] Great Prophets cost 25% less [ICON_PEACE] Faith. [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Holy Sites[ENDCOLOR] provide +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Churches[ENDCOLOR] Use [ICON_PEACE] Faith to purchase Churches (+1 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, +3 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production)[NEWLINE][ICON_PEACE] Faith cost on Quick speed: Church 110.
A golden age begins for the Egyptian civilization.

Carthage has started worshipping a pantheon of gods. Spain has founded the new religion Eastern Orthodoxy in the holy city of Madrid:[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Tithe[ENDCOLOR] +1 [ICON_GOLD] Gold for every 4 followers of this religion[NEWLINE][COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]Mariners' Blessing[ENDCOLOR] [ICON_BUILDING_LIGHTHOUSE] Lighthouses provide +3 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +2 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production.
